items.source: Property sources may be removed, reordered, or replaced; and additional property sources may be added using the MutablePropertySources instance returned from getPropertySources(). The following examples are against the StandardEnvironment implementation of ConfigurableEnvironment, but are generally applicable to any implementation, though particular default property sources may differ.
items.translation: 属性源可以被移除、重新排序或替换；并且可以使用从getPropertySources()返回的MutablePropertySources实例添加额外的属性源。以下示例针对ConfigurableEnvironment的StandardEnvironment实现，但通常适用于任何实现，尽管特定的默认属性源可能有所不同。

items.source: Any existing active profiles will be replaced with the given arguments; call with zero arguments to clear the current set of active profiles. Use addActiveProfile(String) to add a profile while preserving the existing set.
items.translation: 任何现有的活动配置文件都将被给定的参数替换；调用时不带任何参数可清除当前的活动配置文件集。使用addActiveProfile(String)在保留现有集合的同时添加一个配置文件。

items.source: Note that most Environment implementations will include this system environment map as a default PropertySource to be searched. Therefore, it is recommended that this method not be used directly unless bypassing other property sources is expressly intended.

items.source: The parent environment remains unmodified in any case. Note that any changes to the parent environment occurring after the call to merge will not be reflected in the child. Therefore, care should be taken to configure parent property sources and profile information prior to calling merge.
items.translation: 父环境在任何情况下都保持不变。请注意，在调用 `merge` 之后对父环境进行的任何更改都不会反映到子环境中。因此，在调用 `merge` 之前，应小心配置父属性源和配置文件信息。

items.source: For any identically-named PropertySource instance existing in both parent and child, the child instance is to be preserved and the parent instance discarded. This has the effect of allowing overriding of property sources by the child as well as avoiding redundant searches through common property source types — for example, system environment and system properties.
items.translation: 对于在父级和子级中均存在的同名 `PropertySource` 实例，将保留子级实例并丢弃父级实例。这允许子级覆盖属性源，同时避免对公共属性源类型（例如系统环境变量和系统属性）进行冗余搜索。

items.source:
Active and default profile names are also filtered for duplicates, to avoid
confusion and redundant storage.
items.translation: 活动及默认配置文件名称也会进行重复过滤，以避免混淆和冗余存储。

items.source: Return the PropertySources for this Environment in mutable form, allowing for manipulation of the set of PropertySource objects that should be searched when resolving properties against this Environment object. The various MutablePropertySources methods such as addFirst, addLast, addBefore and addAfter allow for fine-grained control over property source ordering. This is useful, for example, in ensuring that certain user-defined property sources have search precedence over default property sources such as the set of system properties or the set of system environment variables.
items.translation: 返回此 Environment 的 PropertySources 的可变形式，允许操作在解析属性时应搜索的 PropertySource 对象集。各种 MutablePropertySources 方法，例如 addFirst、addLast、addBefore 和 addAfter，允许对属性源顺序进行细粒度控制。这在确保某些用户定义的属性源具有搜索优先级（高于默认属性源，如系统属性集或系统环境变量集）时非常有用。
